correctness.rationale: Exactly stated standard inclusive HK update, order, unit normalization and initially connected hypothesis. For each contact pattern the signed-interval constraints have an integral totally unimodular coefficient matrix; each polytope extreme point is binary. Convex mixing with a strict witness proves graph-cell closure; the updated gap is linear in the gaps. The standalone standard-library exact rational enumerator checks all 6858 closed-pattern vertex-gap values through n=6 and direct sharp witnesses. The independent coarse rational grid is supporting evidence only. No later-time claim is made.
